packageRules.description: Python follows Home Assistant: .python-version is written by scripts/setup/update-ha-version, never bumped on its own (the newest Python lacks wheels for HA's dependencies)

A new Home Assistant version is only listed on the Dependency Dashboard: it takes scripts/setup/update-ha-version (HA_VERSION, the matching pytest-homeassistant-custom-component and .python-version together), a PR changing HA_VERSION alone would be incomplete
prBodyNotes: Don't merge this as is: run `./scripts/setup/update-ha-version {{{newVersion}}}` on this branch, it also updates pytest-homeassistant-custom-component and .python-version.

packageRules.description: Each pytest-homeassistant-custom-component version pins exactly one HA version: scripts/setup/update-ha-version updates it together with HA_VERSION
Requirements of the integration itself reach users: listed in the release notes (chore(deps)), unlike all other updates here
